name: @getreka/mcp

tools.name: hybrid_search
tools.description: Call this when you need to find code and don't already know the exact file or symbol name — conceptual questions ("how does X work", "where is Y handled") or locating the code behind a feature. Runs hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword) over the indexed codebase; set mode: "navigate" for a compact map of file locations, symbols, and graph connections (no code bodies), then use the Read tool on the returned paths. Do NOT use for exact strings or known file names (use Grep/Glob) or when you already know a function/class/type name (use find_symbol).

mode.description: content (default): return matching code. navigate: return file locations, symbols, and graph connections only

semanticWeight.description: Weight for semantic vs keyword (0-1, default: 0.7)

language.description: Filter by language (typescript, python, vue, etc.)

layer.description: Filter by architectural layer (api, service, util, etc.)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search documentation in the  project.

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about the  codebase.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Call this when you know a function/class/type NAME and want its exact definition and location — fast symbol-index lookup, faster and more precise than search. Do NOT use for conceptual questions ("how does X work") or locating a feature by topic — use hybrid_search.

symbol.description: Symbol name to find (function, class, type, etc.)

kind.description: Filter by kind: function, class, interface, type, enum, const

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Call this when you need dependency structure: what imports a file, what a change would break (blast radius), or how modules connect — returns file locations plus connected files via import/call relationships (use the Read tool to view code). Do NOT use for finding code by topic or concept (use hybrid_search) or for plain symbol lookup (use find_symbol).

expandHops.description: Number of graph hops to expand (default: 1)

tools.name: index_codebase
tools.description: Index or re-index the  codebase for RAG search.

force.description: Force re-index even if already indexed

tools.name: get_index_status
tools.description: Get the indexing status for  codebase. Results cached for 30 minutes.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Call this once per work item, and only when you learned something non-obvious — a decision, a gotcha, or a new procedure — and include the WHY, not just the what. Persists to durable project memory so future sessions recall it. Do NOT save memories for mechanical changes (typos, renames, version bumps) or restate what the code already says — they pollute recall.

triggerDescription.description: WHEN to recall this memory — a retrieval cue embedded separately from the content (e.g. 'when changing auth middleware or session handling'). Improves recall matching for the situations where the memory matters.

pin.description: Set pin when the user says 'always remember this' / 'load this every session'. 'repo' = always loaded for this project; 'all' = always loaded everywhere.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Call this when past decisions, insights, ADRs, or notes about this project could change your approach — semantic search over agent memory. Do NOT use for searching code (use hybrid_search or Grep) or documentation (use search_docs).

graphRecall.description: Enable graph-aware recall with spreading activation (default: false)

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List recent memories or filter by type/tags. Shows what the agent has remembered.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by ID or clear memories by type.

type.description: Delete all memories of this type

olderThanDays.description: Delete memories older than N days

tools.name: batch_remember
tools.description: Efficiently store multiple memories at once in . Faster than individual remember calls.

factCategory.description: Structured fact category for temporal retrieval

factEntities.description: Named entities: file names, service names, external systems

triggerDescription.description: WHEN to recall this memory — a retrieval cue embedded separately from the content. Improves recall matching.

pin.description: Set pin when the user says 'always remember this' / 'load this every session'. 'repo' = always loaded for this project; 'all' = everywhere.

tools.name: review_memories
tools.description: Get auto-extracted memories pending review in . Shows unvalidated learnings that need human confirmation.

tools.name: promote_memory
tools.description: Promote a quarantine memory to durable storage in . Requires a reason for promotion. Optionally runs quality gates before promotion.

memoryId.description: ID of the memory to promote

runGates.description: Run quality gates before promotion (default: false)

affectedFiles.description: Files affected by this memory (for quality gate checking)

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Call this to read and write your persistent memory files for this project: view a directory or file, create, str_replace, insert, delete, rename — paths live under /memories (e.g. /memories/decisions.md). Call it when you learn something worth keeping across sessions (a decision, a gotcha, a procedure) and to re-read your notes before relying on past context. This is NOT the host's local /memories directory: it is Reka's project-scoped, governed, server-side memory — it survives machines and sessions. New writes are quarantined for review: your own path-based view sees them immediately, but they only enter semantic recall once promoted.

path.description: Path to the memory file or directory (e.g. '/memories' or '/memories/auth.md'). Required for view, create, str_replace, insert and delete.

file_text.description: Content to write to the file (create).

old_str.description: Exact text to find and replace (str_replace).

insert_text.description: Text to insert at the given line (insert).

view_range.description: [start, end] 1-based line range when viewing a file; end -1 reads to EOF (view).

old_path.description: Current path of the file or directory (rename).

new_path.description: New path for the file or directory (rename).

tools.name: record_adr
tools.description: Record an Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Use this to document important architectural decisions, technology choices, and design patterns for .

title.description: Short title for the decision (e.g., 'Use WebSocket for real-time updates')

context.description: Why this decision was needed - the problem or requirement

consequences.description: Positive and negative consequences of this decision

tools.name: get_adrs
tools.description: Get Architecture Decision Records for . Search by topic or list all ADRs.

query.description: Search query (optional - returns all if empty)

tools.name: record_pattern
tools.description: Record an architectural pattern used in . Patterns define how specific types of code should be structured.

description.description: What this pattern is for and when to use it

structure.description: How code following this pattern should be structured (file organization, naming, etc.)

example.description: Example code or file reference demonstrating the pattern

appliesTo.description: Where this pattern applies (e.g., 'backend/src/modules/*', 'all API endpoints')

tools.name: get_patterns
tools.description: Get architectural patterns for . Use to understand how to structure new code.

query.description: Search for patterns by name or description

appliesTo.description: Filter by what patterns apply to (e.g., 'api', 'module')

tools.name: record_tech_debt
tools.description: Record technical debt or architectural violation that needs to be addressed later.

title.description: Short description of the tech debt

location.description: Where in the codebase (file paths, modules)

relatedAdr.description: Related ADR ID if this violates a decision

tools.name: get_tech_debt
tools.description: List technical debt items for .

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a new working session for . Tracks tool usage, file changes, and learnings throughout the session.

sessionId.description: Custom session ID. If omitted, one will be generated.

initialContext.description: Description of what this session is about (e.g., 'fixing auth bug', 'adding new API endpoint').

resumeFrom.description: Session ID to resume from. Carries over context from the previous session.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a working session for . Saves a summary and optionally extracts learnings for future sessions.

summary.description: Summary of what was accomplished during the session.

autoSaveLearnings.description: Automatically save detected learnings to memory (default: true).

feedback.description: Optional feedback about the session (e.g., 'productive', 'too many context switches').

tools.name: context_briefing
tools.description: Call this before changes that span multiple files, touch shared services or exports, or where prior decisions (patterns/ADRs) could affect the approach — one call runs recall + code search + patterns + ADRs + graph blast-radius in parallel and returns a single briefing. Do NOT use for mechanical single-line edits (typos, renames, version bumps, formatting); make those directly.

tools.name: setup_project
tools.description: Configure Claude Code for RAG integration — a thin delegate of `npx @getreka/cli init`, which is the canonical setup path (it also mints API keys and checks the Docker stack). Creates/updates .mcp.json (single "rag" server entry; merges legacy "reka"/"<project>-rag" entries), adds RAG instructions to CLAUDE.md, and configures permissions. Call after index_codebase on a new project.

ragApiUrl.description: RAG API URL (default: from MCP env)

ragApiKey.description: RAG API key (default: from MCP env)

updateClaudeMd.description: Add RAG section to CLAUDE.md (default: true)

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Run a specialized agent for . Agents autonomously research, review, or analyze using multiple tool calls. Returns result + reasoning trace.

type.description: Agent type: research, review, documentation, refactor, or test

task.description: The task for the agent to perform

maxIterations.description: Maximum ReAct iterations (default: varies by agent type)

tools.name: get_agent_types
tools.description: List available agent types for  with descriptions.

tools.name: get_quality_report
tools.description: Get LLM quality metrics for . Shows JSON parse rates, latency percentiles, thinking trace rates, and alerts.

instructions: Recall-first protocol: before starting a non-trivial task, call `recall` with the task's key terms (ticket IDs alone match poorly — include words describing the problem). Use `context_briefing` before multi-file changes. After completing a work item where you learned something non-obvious (a decision, gotcha, or procedure), call `remember` once with tags and a triggerDescription of when it should resurface. Prefer `hybrid_search`/`find_symbol` over shell grep for conceptual or symbol lookups.
